title: Nutritious American Seitan Burger
description: A vegan-friendly, post-workout American dish featuring a briny and aerated seitan burger patty, served on a sesame seed burger bun, cooked to perfection in a fondue pot. This dish is a great way to replenish energy after a workout.
instructions: In a fondue pot, combine 2 cups of vegetable broth and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the seitan to the fondue pot and cook for 10 minutes, or until heated through.
While the seitan is cooking, toast the sesame seed burger buns.
Assemble the burgers by spreading vegan mayonnaise on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked seitan patty, diced onion, diced bell pepper, sliced lettuce, tomato slices, and pickles.
Top with the top bun and serve immediately.
If using vegan cheese slices, place them on top of the seitan patty before adding the toppings.
Let each person assemble their own burger to their liking.
